content:
## Salesforce, Inc. (CRM) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Salesforce’s Agentforce annual recurring revenue exceeded **$1.5 billion** in fiscal second-quarter 2027, up more than **240% year over year**; the company’s full-year revenue guidance was **$46.1 billion–$46.4 billion** (CNBC).
- A September 23 article cited Salesforce’s **$50 billion buyback**, fiscal-2026 free cash flow of **$14.402 billion**, and second-quarter free cash flow of **$1.098 billion** (247WallSt).
- Salesforce co-founder Marc Benioff and President Miguel Milano had shares withheld for taxes on September 23; Milano’s withholding was **1,001 shares at $233.28** (SEC filing summary, Stock Titan).

## Phillips 66 (PSX) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Cloudflare, Inc. (NET) `[Communications & Networking]`
- A Cloudflare director’s trust sold **5,000 shares at $353.1501** under a trading plan on September 23 (SEC filing summary, Stock Titan).

## Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Meta COO Javier Olivan sold **1,575 shares at $680.27** under a trading plan on September 23 (SEC filing summary, Stock Titan).
- Meta product chief’s trust also sold shares under a trading plan on September 23; the filing summary did not specify the transaction size (SEC filing summary, Stock Titan).
- Meta’s Muse AI agent added Shopify store browsing and checkout capabilities, and a September 23 report listed Shopify, PayPal, Expedia, and Instacart among Muse-related partners (Dove Journal).
- Morgan Stanley said Meta’s Muse could increase communication volumes as AI agents complete more tasks on users’ behalf, potentially increasing demand for Twilio services (StockTwits).

## Zscaler, Inc. (ZS) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Natera, Inc. (NTRA) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window
- Natera’s September 22 regulatory announcement that Japan’s Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency approved Signatera as a companion diagnostic for muscle-invasive bladder cancer was cited as the catalyst for the prior session’s **5.2%** rise; it predates the requested September 23 window (StockStory; Yahoo Finance).

## Super Micro Computer, Inc. (SMCI) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window
- September 23 coverage described semiconductor strength as being driven by AI-infrastructure demand, including reported gains of **14.2% for Marvell**, **21.7% for AMD**, and **22.6% for Intel** during the week; no source in the gathered results directly attributed September 23 SMCI trading to a specific lead stock (Investing.com).

## Circle Internet Group (CRCL) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window
- A September 23 market report attributed Circle’s broader pullback to cryptocurrency-sector risk aversion as Bitcoin fell below **$69,000** and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index reached “extreme fear”; the report concerned a separate move and did not identify a new Circle-specific announcement in the requested window (Tickeron).

## Twilio Inc. (TWLO) `[Communications & Networking]`
- Twilio rose as high as **2.4%** intraday on September 23, reaching its highest level since **November 2021**, amid discussion of AI-agent-driven communications demand (StockTwits).
- Morgan Stanley said Meta’s Muse AI agent could increase communication volumes as agents complete tasks for users, potentially creating additional demand for Twilio services (StockTwits).
- Twilio’s September 23 move followed a prior-session analyst-action catalyst: Rosenblatt and TD Cowen had raised their price targets, according to a September 23 market recap; the recap did not provide the old and new targets (StockStory).

## Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. (CYPH) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window
- No named sector lead stock or sympathy driver was identified in the gathered September 23–24 sources.

## Strive, Inc. (ASST) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window
